description: Reverse stripped Go and Rust binaries — recover symbols from pclntab/moduledata and panic metadata, then navigate language-specific idioms. Load when a stripped ELF/PE/Mach-O shows Go or Rust runtime residue. Signals: "go.buildid", "runtime.main" / "main.main", "panic:" or "rust_begin_unwind" strings, /rustc/ or src/*.rs paths, huge static binary with no symbols, Go malware, a Rust release build.
